Privacy Policy

The Royal Game of Ur for iOS and Android. Last updated 25 October 2026.

In short: The Royal Game of Ur does not collect any data about you. It has no accounts, no ads, no analytics and no tracking, and the game works offline. The only thing it sells is one optional unlock, paid for through the App Store or Google Play.

What the app stores on your device

The app keeps a few things on your device only, so the game remembers them next time:

  • your settings: player names, stone colours, board design, language, sound and the shake-to-roll switch;
  • your game statistics: the results of games played on this device, shown in the Stats panel.

This information never leaves your device. Lumoxia cannot see it. You can erase the statistics at any time with “Reset all statistics” in the Stats panel, and deleting the app removes everything.

What the app does not do

  • The game itself sends nothing to the internet or to any server of ours.
  • It does not use analytics, crash reporting, advertising or third-party software that collects data.
  • It does not track you across other apps or websites and does not ask for tracking permission.
  • It does not ask for your location, contacts, photos, camera, microphone or any account.
  • It does not see or store your payment details. Apple or Google handles every payment.

The optional purchase

The app offers one optional, one-time purchase that opens every board and every stone colour. You can also unlock boards and colours for free by playing games. There is no subscription and there are no ads.

Apple or Google takes the payment and keeps the record of it, under their own privacy policies. Lumoxia receives no payment details and no personal information, and never learns who bought. To show that you own the unlock, the app asks the App Store or Google Play on your device, which may use the internet for that check. Nothing else is sent.

Retention, deletion and sharing

Lumoxia holds no data about you, so there is nothing to keep, delete or hand over, and no consent to withdraw. What the app stores stays on your device, and deleting the app removes it. Lumoxia shares no data with anyone. The record of a purchase is kept by Apple or Google, so ask them about it.

Motion sensor (shake to roll)

If you switch on “shake to roll” (it is off by default), the app reads your device’s motion sensor while the game screen is showing, only to detect a shake. The readings are used on the spot and then discarded. They are never saved or sent anywhere.

Links that open in your browser

The Rules panel has links to other websites (for example the Lumoxia pages, a history video and the credits for the sound tools) and to these pages. When you tap one, your browser opens it. That website then deals with you under its own privacy policy, which Lumoxia does not control.

Children

Because the app collects no personal information, it collects none from children either. Purchases are made through the App Store or Google Play, so their own parental controls decide whether a child can buy. Lumoxia does not control them.

This website

If you choose a language, this site remembers your choice in your browser on your own device. It is never sent anywhere. The site sets no cookies.

Changes to this policy

If the app ever changes what it does with data, this page will be updated and the date above before the change ships.

Contact

Questions about privacy: rgur-support@lumoxia.art.
